arguments.command:
cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

The default now preserves Unicode and CSV field boundaries, in input order.
Comma, quote, CR and LF trigger quoting; embedded quotes are doubled.

This is a deterministic executable-component comparison, not an instruction-
following/model-policy experiment. No provider calls or token comparisons apply.
The historical defect is the initial CLI's default `baseline` configuration:
it removes non-ASCII characters and leaves delimiters unescaped. The prepared
revision already fixed the default for the two original cases. This finish also
fixes bare CR quoting; it does not claim the prepared revision failed Unicode
or comma/quote handling.

## Reviewed observations

| Case | baseline | full/default | without-unicode | without-escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unicode | mismatch | pass | mismatch | pass |
| escaping | mismatch | pass | pass | mismatch |
| order | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| line-breaks | mismatch | pass | pass | mismatch |
| trailing-space | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| empty-and-types | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| empty-row | pass | pass | pass | pass |

Mismatches in `baseline` are ASCII loss or unescaped field separators;
ablations isolate those components, not independent improvement evidence.
`without-unicode` retains escaping; `without-escaping` retains Unicode.
`baseline` disables both. All conditions use identical inputs and runtime.
The initial default is equivalent to explicit baseline on these cases.

`tests/evidence/prepared-results.json` preserves the original two-case results
and source hash. `before-cr-fix.json` records the prepared source on the expanded
suite: full/default additionally failed line-breaks. `results.json` records the
finished source: full/default pass all seven. Each contains actual output, not
completion claims. Current records include per-case reasons and source, case,
and runner hashes. No execution failures occurred in these recorded runs.

These are small, selected regression cases, not representative workload or
statistical evidence. The original two are reused diagnostics. Added cases are
regressions, not held-out validation. Exact canonical serialization is graded;
equivalent unnecessarily quoted CSV is deliberately rejected. This tests
functional output, not policy compliance or recovery behavior.

## Reproduce locally

Prerequisite: Node.js (recorded runtime in evidence), repository root, no network.

```
node tests/run.mjs
node tests/run.mjs --output /tmp/csv-results-new.json
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/results.json
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/before-cr-fix.json
node tests/prepared-study.mjs --output /tmp/csv-original-study-new
```

Output destinations must not already exist. Fresh runs execute the current
`app.mjs`; configuration names select its actual implementation, not copied
policy fixtures. Replay regrades captured stdout without executing the CLI.
The runner self-checks correct, incorrect, reordered, whitespace-transformed,
and semantically equivalent output before execution. Exact LF termination is
checked without trimming. Exit zero means observed outcomes match the declared
matrix, including intentional control failures; inspect per-case ratings.
The original study used trimEnd and is retained only to reproduce the original
two-case diagnostic; use the current runner for regressions.

Evidence contains only public-safe task data and program output. The unrelated
ignored local runtime context is omitted entirely; no task inputs or outputs
were removed. No model responses, credentials, or private runtime fields are
published. A shell attempt to use unavailable Python failed during editing;
Node performed the edit instead. That tooling issue is not a CSV failure.
EOF

Run regressions with `node tests/run.mjs`. See `REPORT.md` for reviewed
observations, control configurations, and saved-score replay commands.
EOF

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+
+const hash = text => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected + '\n';
+// Exercise the same exact-output grader used for executed CLI results.
+assert(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b'));
+assert(!grade('b,a\n', 'a,b'));
+assert(!grade('a,b \n', 'a,b'));
+assert(!grade('a,b', 'a,b'));
+assert(grade('a, b  \n', 'a, b  '));
+// Narrow acceptance contract: canonical minimal quoting, LF row terminator.
+assert(!grade('"a",b\n', 'a,b'));
+
+const casesText = fs.readFileSync('tests/cases.json', 'utf8');
+const cases = JSON.parse(casesText);
+const conditions = ['baseline', 'full', 'without-unicode', 'without-escaping', 'default'];
+const expectedPass = (condition, id) => {
+  if (condition === 'baseline') return !['unicode', 'escaping', 'line-breaks'].includes(id);
+  if (condition === 'without-unicode') return id !== 'unicode';
+  if (condition === 'without-escaping') return !['escaping', 'line-breaks'].includes(id);
+  return true;
+};
+const rate = row => row.error || row.status !== 0 ? 'infrastructure-error'
+  : grade(row.stdout, row.expected) ? 'pass' : 'output-mismatch';
+
+if (process.argv[2] === '--replay') {
+  const record = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
+  for (const row of record.results) assert.equal(rate(row), row.rating);
+  console.log(`Replayed ${record.results.length} ratings`);
+} else {
+  const source = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs');
+  const results = [];
+  // Interleave configurations on the same fixed inputs.
+  for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const args = ['app.mjs', JSON.stringify(task.input)];
+    if (condition !== 'default') args.push(condition);
+    const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, {encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 5000});
+    const row = {condition, case: task.id, input: task.input, expected: task.expected,
+      stdout: run.stdout, stderr: run.stderr, status: run.status,
+      error: run.error?.message ?? null};
+    row.rating = rate(row);
+    row.reason = row.rating === 'pass' ? 'Exact canonical CSV and LF terminator'
+      : row.rating === 'output-mismatch' ? 'Output differs from expected CSV' : 'Execution unavailable or failed';
+    results.push(row);
+  }
+  const record = {source: 'app.mjs', sourceSha256: hash(source),
+    casesSha256: hash(casesText), runnerSha256: hash(fs.readFileSync('tests/run.mjs')),
+    runtime: process.version, conditions, cases, results};
+  if (process.argv[2] === '--output') {
+    fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[3], JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + '\n', {flag: 'wx'});
+  }
+  for (const row of results) {
+    console.log(`${row.condition}/${row.case}: ${row.rating}`);
+    if ((row.rating === 'pass') !== expectedPass(row.condition, row.case) || row.rating === 'infrastructure-error') process.exitCode = 1;
+  }
+}
